step1_analysis.description: An inductively degenerated common-source Low Noise Amplifier (LNA) designed for a 900-MHz GSM receiver. It uses inductive source degeneration (L1) and a gate inductor (L2) for 50-ohm input matching, and an LC tank (L3 and parasitic/added capacitance) at the drain for narrowband amplification.

paper_reference.title: A 900-MHz Dual-Conversion Low-IF GSM Receiver in 0.35-m CMOS

Center_Frequency.description: The frequency at which the LNA voltage gain peaks, determined by the output LC tank.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by L3 (8.7nH) and total drain capacitance (Cout ~ 3.5pF). f = 1 / (2*pi*sqrt(8.7nH * 3.5pF)) ≈ 912 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Must be tuned to the 900 MHz GSM band as specified in the paper.

Voltage_Gain.description: Peak AC voltage gain at the center frequency.

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain ≈ gm * R_tank. With gm ≈ 45 mS and R_tank ≈ 333 ohms (three 1k resistors in parallel), Gain ≈ 15 V/V = 23.5 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: A typical LNA provides 15-20 dB of gain to suppress the noise contribution of subsequent mixer stages.

Power_Consumption.description: Total DC power consumed by the LNA from the 1.8V supply.

sky130_expected.reasoning: LNA power consumption is typically a few milliwatts to balance noise figure, linearity, and power constraints.

Input_Impedance.description: Magnitude of the input impedance at 900 MHz.

sky130_expected.calculation: Zin ≈ s(L1+L2) + 1/(s*Cgs) + (gm/Cgs)*L1. The inductive degeneration term (gm/Cgs)*L1 is designed to be 50 ohms.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard RF design requires matching the input to a 50-ohm antenna/filter source.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure LNA center frequency, peak voltage gain, input impedance, and DC power consumption.
step3_testbench.spice:
* 900-MHz LNA Testbench
.lib "sky130_fd_pr/models/sky130.lib.spice" tt

.param Cp=1.2p
.param W_m1=90u
.param L_m1=0.15u

* DUT (Resistor values appended and missing NMOS added)
L1 N2 GND 2nH
L2 In N0 22nH
L3 VDD OUT 8.7nH
R1 VDD OUT 1k
R2 VDD OUT 1k
R3 VDD OUT 1k
C1 In GND 2pF
C2 N0 GND {Cp}
XM1 OUT N0 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W={W_m1} L={L_m1}
Cout OUT GND 3.5p

* Sources
VVDD VDD GND 1.8
VIN In GND DC 0.7 AC 1 SIN(0.7 0.01 900MEG 0 0)

.control
* DC Operating Point
op
let id_m1 = -i(VVDD)
let power = id_m1 * 1.8
print id_m1 power

* AC Analysis
ac dec 100 100MEG 10G
let gain_db = vdb(OUT)
let zin_mag = mag(v(In)/(-i(VIN)))

meas ac max_gain MAX gain_db
meas ac peak_freq MAX_AT gain_db
meas ac gain_900mhz find gain_db at=900MEG
meas ac zin_900mhz find zin_mag at=900MEG

* Transient Analysis
tran 10p 10n
meas tran vout_pp pp v(OUT)

quit
.endc
.end
